name: Raminfo Limited
about: Raminfo Limited provides technology solutions to government, fintech, healthcare, energy, IoT, analytics, and engineering sectors in India. The company offers cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, machine learning, early warning dissemination system, digital library, and learning management system for schools, colleges and universities; GIS-based asset management system; solar solutions rooftop ground-mounted; agri-logistics, such as crop management information system using AI /ML; solutions for remote health monitoring, telemedicine services, electronic health cards, healthcare analytics, and health ATMs; agri spray drones; health information management system; lab information management system; mobile-first banking for rural users to smart integrations for digital payments; and skill development management systems. It serves public sector, smart energy, agri-logistics, healthcare, fintech, and education and skilling. The company was formerly known as Ram Informatics Limited and changed its name to Raminfo Limited in September 2014. Raminfo Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
